slides.title: Small shop owner, the night before Black Friday: expectation vs reality
slides.body: (it's Thanksgiving. the pie can wait 5 minutes.)

slides.myth: Window display done. Doorbusters tagged. Ready.
slides.fact: Staring at the business license on the wall, trying to read the expiration date.

slides.myth: The seasonal hire starts at 6 AM, fully onboarded.
slides.fact: Their paperwork is three screenshots in a group chat.

slides.myth: The pop-up at the holiday market is all set.
slides.fact: The organizer wants a current insurance certificate. Yours says 2025.
The renewal notice went to an inbox nobody has opened since summer.

slides.label: the fix
slides.title: Check the dates tonight. Sell tomorrow.
slides.body: license, permits, insurance. one look, five minutes, then back to dinner.

slides.label: save this
slides.title: Which reality are you living right now?
slides.body: save this for next year's Black Friday eve.
